title: ResearchLedger Run Manifest
description: research/runs/R<NNNN>/manifest.json, written by `researchledger run`. Immutable once written.

command.description: Shell-quoted form of command_argv, for display.

environment.description: Relative path to this run's environment.json, or null.

environment_digest.description: SHA-256 of environment.json's canonical bytes, so drift is detectable without opening it.

hardware.description: Best-effort, non-sensitive machine info (CPU model/count, total RAM, GPU names/driver, CUDA version).

env_vars.description: Allowlisted environment variables only (see --env-allow) — never a full env dump.

metrics.description: Relative path to this run's metrics.json, or null if the command produced none.

metrics_sha256.description: SHA-256 of metrics.json's exact bytes at seal time — the run's scientific result is otherwise the one file nothing checks the hash of. Null iff metrics is null.

inputs.description: Input datasets hashed via --data (file or directory; a directory's hash covers every file's relative path and content). Order-independent.

previous_run_hash.description: SHA-256 of the immediately preceding run's manifest.json at the time this run was created — null only for the very first run in the ledger. Absent entirely on runs recorded before this field existed (schema_version < the one that added it); those are 'legacy unchained' runs, not broken ones.
